title: The karaoke box: the front desk and one booth
caption: For the karaoke club (day 5 in the plan). The karaoke box's glass door at the shop street's east end (south row) now opens onto its front desk; the stairs at the back go up to one booth. It loads with ?place=karaoke or ?place=karaoke_booth. Nobody is there yet. On day 2 the door stays shut with the other shops.

sections.title: The door
sections.caption: Before and after: the door off the arcade. Its 準備中 card is now up only on day 2.

sections.title: The front desk
sections.caption: The desk with the staff's terminal, baskets of microphones and the price board behind it; the drinks bar; the song catalogues and a waiting bench by the door; posters; the stairs up at the back.

sections.title: The booth
sections.caption: Up the stairs: the screen with a song's words on it, benches round a low table, the song selector in its cradle, two microphones, a tambourine and the menu, a small mirror ball, coloured lights.
